overview: The **Product Discovery** drop-in emits search-related events including loading states, search results, and errors, enabling real-time search feedback and integration with other storefront components.

search/results.description: Emitted when search results are returned. This includes products matching the search query, facets for filtering, and pagination information.

results.description: The search results including matched products, total count, and applied filters.

query.description: The search query that was executed, including search terms and applied filters.

search/error.description: Emitted when an error occurs during search operations such as query execution or facet loading.

error.description: Error details including message, code, and context about which search operation failed.

search/initialized.description: Emitted when the product discovery component completes initialization. This indicates the search interface is ready for user input.

facets/updated.description: Emitted when search facets (filters) are applied or removed. This event is useful for tracking filter selections and updating the product list.

facets.description: The currently applied facet selections, organized by facet type (category, price range, color, etc.).
